text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Wants(x, y) ::: x wants to do y.
Compose(x) ::: x can compose music.
HasAccess(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Conclusion:
(Likes(George, music) ∧ HasAccess(George, program)) → Compose(George)
Premises:
Likes(George, music) → Wants(George, compose)
HasAccess(George, program) → Compose(George)
(Compose(George) ∧ Wants(George, compose)) → Compose(George)
